portfolio_view: Four picks spanning Financial Services (KARURVYSYA), Pharma CDMO (LAURUSLABS), Aerospace/Defence Capital Goods (PTCIL), and Textile exports (PGIL) — a genuine sector spread with one steady-quality compounder (KVB) balancing three higher-beta, theme-adjacent growth names. Given the DEFENSIVE regime (46.8% breadth) and that three of the four picks carry rich-to-extreme valuations, lean on the half-size default and don't chase add-ons. STOVEKRAFT (daily-analyst BUY, 14 Oct) was dropped: research found an undisclosed-to-the-screen promoter pledge (8.76% of capital, Bajaj Finance) and a Hold→Sell brokerage downgrade on moat-less fundamentals — a direct contradiction of the mechanical "no pledge" read. FINCABLES (daily-analyst BUY, 06 Oct) was passed over too — thematic intelligence names it a copper-duty-push casualty (HURT list), a live margin headwind the mechanical score doesn't price in.
theme_read: Defence & aerospace sits at the top of the heat map (91/100) and PTCIL's inclusion is real, but the specific GE Aerospace linkage the desk cites for it is unconfirmed — the genuine driver is Aerolloy's Safran/Airbus titanium-casting wins, so price here is ahead of the headline but roughly in line with the verified order book. Pharma CDMO & API is a lukewarm bucket (heat 50.3, only 10% actionable) yet LAURUSLABS is decoupling cleanly on its own ARV-to-CDMO pivot — a case where theme heat understates a single strong name rather than misleads on it. Textiles & apparel PLI (heat 59, -3.9% 3m) is the inverse problem: the sell-side narrative (US trade deal "finalised") is running ahead of actual policy, since no signed text exists and India isn't uniquely favored over Bangladesh — PGIL's thesis has to stand on its own capacity/customer diversification, not the theme. Data centres & digital infrastructure is the most genuinely hot, under-crowded theme on the map, but both confirmed beneficiaries (STLTECH, HFCL) carry no tradeable plan, making it currently unplayable here. Financial market infrastructure doesn't touch KARURVYSYA at all — its strength is pure fundamentals, independent of any mapped theme.
